:::{#exm-ci-log-OR}

#### Confidence interval for a beetle log odds ratio

For the `beetles` [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression) (`beetles_glm_ungrouped`),
let $\vx = (1, 1.8)\'$ and $\vxs = (1, 1.7)\'$.
The code below applies @thm-ci-log-OR,
and compares the interval with the one obtained by scaling the confidence interval for the dose coefficient by $0.1$,
which is valid here because $\diffvx = (0, 0.1)\'$:

```{r}
#| label: exm-ci-log-OR-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_dx <- c(0, 1.8 - 1.7)
ex_est <- sum(ex_dx * coef(beetles_glm_ungrouped))
ex_se <- sqrt(drop(t(ex_dx) %*% vcov(beetles_glm_ungrouped) %*% ex_dx))
ex_ci <- ex_est + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * ex_se
ex_ci_scaled <- 0.1 * confint.default(beetles_glm_ungrouped)["dose", ]
```

The estimated log odds ratio is `r round(ex_est, 3)`,
with 95% confidence interval
(`r round(ex_ci[1], 3)`, `r round(ex_ci[2], 3)`).
The scaled interval for the dose coefficient is
(`r round(ex_ci_scaled[1], 3)`, `r round(ex_ci_scaled[2], 3)`),
which agrees.

:::
